Plural все. Core Russian det meaning 'all, whole; everyone, everything' in everyday speech.
Lasting forever. Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('eternal, everlasting, perpetual').
Never-ending. Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('eternal, everlasting, perpetual').

examples.text: Знаешь, что это за часы? Швейцария! Они вечные.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'team; command' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Agreeing, often reluctantly. Core Russian part meaning 'all right, OK' in everyday speech.

париться.gloss: to steam oneself in a bathhouse; (slang) to sweat over

meanings.en: to steam oneself (and beat with birch branches) in a Russian bathhouse
meanings.note: Не парься = don't sweat it. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to steam oneself in a bathhouse; (slang) to sweat over', paired with 'попариться'.

Не парься = don't sweat it. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to steam oneself in a bathhouse; (slang) to sweat over', paired with 'попариться'.

examples.text: В субботу мы паримся в бане.

посидеть.gloss: to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)

meanings.note: Perfective of limited duration. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'сидеть'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)', paired with 'сидеть'.

Посиди с ним = stay with him. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'сидеть'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)', paired with 'сидеть'.

examples.trans: Stay with Vika for a while.
Let's sit in a café for a bit.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'potential' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'слабиться'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to relax', paired with 'расслабляться'.

examples.text: Ваня, расслабься. В этот раз без обмана.
